# Thread & Vine Hall at Gibson Mill

> Event venue and music hall in a restored 1899 textile mill at 325 McGill Ave NW, Suite 148, Concord, North Carolina 28027. Five rooms for gatherings of 10 to 600: weddings, corporate events, celebrations, Christian concerts and worship nights, churches and nonprofits. A ministry of SOJO Church. Phone (828) 459-6749, email events@threadandvinehall.com.

## Key facts
- Capacity: The Loom up to 600 standing; No. 6 Lounge 50; Spinning Room about 50 and Thread Room 15 (both open January 2027); the Bobbin under 30. An outdoor deck comes with Loom events.
- 2027 rates: the Loom $3,150 Saturday, $2,100 Friday, $1,260 Monday to Thursday. Hourly rooms $35 to $105 per hour. Workday package from $840/day; Celebration from $245.
- Churches, ministries and partner nonprofits: 50% off room rental Monday to Thursday, 25% off Friday and Saturday; tables, chairs and linens included.
- Every event: $250 cleaning fee. Sound and AV: $100 per hour.
- 50% non-refundable deposit holds the date; balance due 30 days before.
- Saturdays end by 11:00 PM; Fridays until 2:00 AM; Sunday mornings reserved for SOJO Church.
- Outside caterers welcome. Alcohol only at approved private events, served by a licensed bartender. Concerts are alcohol-free and feature Christian artists.
- Free parking in Lot A on the Gibson Mill campus.
